data.content_ref: inline:The target depends on SRC_005 by inheriting the covering principle of ordinal position: overtaking the occupant of slot N transfers you into slot N, so overtaking the runner in second place puts you into second place. The target abstracts this principle into a general rule that resolves the riddle and unifies the mechanistic stance. Refuted if overtaking is defined as mere physical passage without positional exchange, or if 'second place' is interpreted as second from the back of the field rather than from the front.
